blocks.caption: Figure 38.3-1 illustrates how channel 0 is configured to increment independently on the positive edge of sig_ch0_u*n* while channel 1 is disabled (see subsection 38.2 for how to disable channel 1). The configuration of channel 0 is shown below.

c.v: is low, the counter mode specified for the low state turns on, in this case it is Increment mode.
is high, the counter mode specified for the low state turns on, in this case it is Disable mode.
=1: The counter increments on the positive edge of sig_ch0_u
=0: The counter idles on the negative edge of sig_ch0_u
=5: When pulse_cnt counts up to PCNT_CNT_H_LIM_U
